race.comment: GRINGOTTS (1) arrives chasing his third straight win in this race and gets his chance from the low draw. Protested successfully with the 62kg for a close up third in the LR Big Dance over this trip at Randwick. Another top-three finish is on the cards in a very strong contest. GOD'S WINDOW (4) returns from a let-up. Won the G1 Epsom Hcp two back, then thrown in the deep end with a plugging fourth in the G1 King Charles III Stakes at Randwick over 1609m. Since fitted with a 1050m trial. Tempo suits and can take a hand in the finish. TAVI TIME (10) anchored with big weights in his three runs back and the blinkers and tongue tie come off today. Well placed at the weights and must be kept safe. MATIAS (13) is edging towards a victory and no shock to see him take this out nor will it be any great shock to see OSIPENKO (14) get involved down off the limit. He continues to race well.
